{{Quote|I was thinking of staying out in the Lake Country. There's some places out there that are very isolated.|[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
The '''Lake Country''' was a remote area of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] located approximately two hours by [[V-19 landspeeder|Gian]] [[Landspeeder/Legends|speeder]] from [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], that was dominated by beautiful lakes, surrounded by mountains and valleys.

==Description==
[[File:Lake_Retreat_2.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]].]]
Wide meadows of grass and wildflowers sat among the waterfalls and lakes, and much of the planet's native [[Shaak/Legends|shaak]] population made their homes there. Sparsely populated, the only families that lived amid its fields were ranchers and agriculturalists. Larger estates like [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] retreat&mdash;once owned by [[Omar Berenko/Legends|Omar Berenko]] and later by the [[Naberrie family/Legends|Naberrie family]]&mdash; and [[Convergence/Legends|Convergence]], the sprawling estate of [[House Palpatine/Legends|House of Palpatine]] were situated along lakes and waterways in the region. It was also the site of [[Amidala's Beach|Amidala's private beach]].
